name: Fabiola Valamparampil
message:
Dear Team,

I am reaching out on behalf of our organisation to express our interest in engaging your multidisciplinary consulting engineering services, including structural and civil engineering, fire safety and disability access consulting, building surveying, project and construction management, insurance and forensic engineering, and assigned certifier services across commercial, residential, industrial, infrastructure, and life sciences sectors in Ireland and the UK. We would like to explore the possibility of procuring these services and would appreciate details on your pricing structures, current availability, and the steps required to move forward. Could you please send this information directly to fabiola@elitesfinishesgroup.com so we can review and progress accordingly? We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Fabiola Valamparampil.
